method: Every answer the scorer did not pass (152 failed, 26 unscored) was read and labelled by Claude (AI assistance) on 2026-10-17, for the author to check. A label is correct only if the answer states the expected value, in the right unit, and states no conflicting value as the answer. A bare number with no unit counts as correct; a wrong unit ('11 hours', '0 miles') does not, but 'per year' after a right unit is not a wrong unit. An answer that stops before giving a final value is incorrect. The 522 answers the scorer passed were audited the same way on 2026-10-17 (Claude, for the author to check): their 103 distinct pairs of task and final line (102 distinct lines) were read against the expected values, and every one states the expected value in a fitting unit, so none is labelled here.

kinds.stopped_at_4096: Stopped mid-answer when the call reached 4,096 tokens in total, the server's default context window at the time; the trace does not record whether the server truncated the prompt.
